gloss: nothing ventured, nothing gained; go for it and accept whatever happens; give it a shot

definitions.gloss: nothing ventured, nothing gained; go for it and accept whatever happens; give it a shot
definitions.explanation: A proverb encouraging bold action despite uncertain outcomes — charge forward even if you might fail.

examples.japanese: {当|あ}たって{砕|くだ}けろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I took the challenge with a nothing-ventured-nothing-gained spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わからない⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{当|あ}たって{砕|くだ}けろだ。
examples.english: I don't know the outcome, but I'll go for it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{告白|こくはく}する→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っていた→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{当|あ}たって{砕|くだ}けろ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I was hesitating about confessing my feelings, but I decided to go for it and spoke up.

notes:
A proverb encouraging bold action despite uncertain outcomes. Literally means "hit it and shatter" — implying you should charge forward even if you might break. The imperative form ⟦{砕|くだ}けろ→砕ける：04667_kudakeru⟧ gives it a forceful, motivational tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {当|あ}たって{砕|くだ}けろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: the spirit of "go for it"
- {当|あ}たって{砕|くだ}けろだ: (I'll) just go for it
- {当|あ}たって{砕|くだ}けろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: with a "nothing to lose" attitude

USAGE:
Used when facing a daunting situation — job interviews, confessions, business proposals, or any situation where the outcome is uncertain but inaction is worse. It is an encouragement to take action despite fear of failure.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {虎穴|こけつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|い}らずんば{虎子|こじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}→得る：02014_eru⟧ず: nothing ventured, nothing gained (more literary)
- ⟦とりあえず→とりあえず：05209_toriaezu⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧みる: just try it for now — more casual, less dramatic
